description: Source code for linenoise, a lightweight line editing library implementing command line input with features like history and tab completion.

methods.name: linenoise
methods.description: Main API function to read a line of input with prompt, handling editing, history, and completion.

methods.name: linenoiseSetCompletionCallback
methods.description: Register a callback for tab completion.

methods.name: linenoiseAddCompletion
methods.description: Add a completion option for the current input.

methods.name: linenoiseHistoryAdd
methods.description: Add a line to the input history.

methods.name: linenoiseHistorySetMaxLen
methods.description: Set maximum number of history entries.

methods.name: linenoiseHistorySave
methods.description: Save input history to a file.

methods.name: linenoiseHistoryLoad
methods.description: Load input history from a file.
